lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: How much further?

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: Soon.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: ... Okay.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: That weapon you're using.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: You called it Seven Dwarves, didn't you?

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: That's the same weapon that Snow White uses.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: How did you know that?
We know each other. She's lent us a hand multiple times before.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: My goodness, you all are something.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: My question is, what are you doing with Snow White's weapon?

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: I'm holding onto it, that's all.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Have you met her?

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: No, I haven't. We don't know each other.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: So how...

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: I intend to meet her and return it to her.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: It's just that I haven't met her yet.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: Could you help me find her?
We'll try.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: Snow White! And the Goddess squad...

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: Cinderella doesn't get along with the rest of the squad.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: They fought.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: So they can't meet.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: They did? When?

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: A long time ago.
How long ago, exactly?

lines.speaker: shifty_r
lines.text: Everyone, lay low and check your 10 o'clock.

lines.speaker: shifty_r
lines.text: Behemoth should be there.
We follow Shifty's instructions and get down, focusing our gaze in the direction indicated.
I don't see anyth...
*Thump thump thump thump*

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What the...

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Is she... climbing up the building?
Using her clamps to hold onto the walls, Behemoth is scampering up the face of a building.
Each time one of her clamps grips onto the wall, the entire building shakes.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: As long as there's a wall, it looks like she can ascend to just about any height.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: She just scaled that entire thing. She's on the rooftop now.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: She seems to be searching for something.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Us, I presume.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Or the coffin, to be more precise.
Shifty, how far out from us is she?

lines.speaker: shifty_r
lines.text: Approximately three kilometers.
Can we take a shot at her from here?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: A single hit won't inflict significant damage on her.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: The only attack which will serve any function is a concentrated, continuous assault.
Then we have no choice. We'll have to move carefully and avoid detection.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: I'm not so sure of that.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: I think we can take her.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: We may know her weak spot,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: but there's no knowing what else she could have up her sleeve.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: And let's not forget the fact she's most likely able to transform herself somehow.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Most importantly, we have no way of countering the crystals that she commands.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: So stealth is still our best option.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Oh... alright.
Given how much experience this team has with Heretics, I'm confident we'd stand a chance in a fight,
but a bit of caution never hurt anyone. There are still too many uncertainties at this point.
I speak to the team while keeping my eyes squarely fixed on Behemoth.
Let's keep moving. Everyone, stay low. Combat should only be used as a last resort.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: What's wrong?
She seems to be looking this way.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: What?
Yes, she's absolutely looking in our direction.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: What did you expect when you made it so obvious that you were spying on her?

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Fortunately, we've got some distance on her. Let's circle around and...

lines.speaker: shifty_r
lines.text: Behemoth is moving.
Behemoth fixes her clamps onto the wall of the building,
then begins to crouch down.
... No way.
She crouches down even further.
Everyone get out of the way! Here she comes!
*Craaaash*!
A massive sound reminiscent of an explosion rings out, and part of the building wall collapses.
Immediately after, my view is obscured by a massive clamp.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Commander!
There is another resounding bang, causing my ears to ring and the ground to shake.
I fall to the ground and tumble through the dirt.
I quickly recover and look in front of me...
only to see Behemoth.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: How the hell did she close that distance so quickly?!

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: It defies all common sense.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Hmm, I didn't expect you to be able to avoid that.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: I'll commend you on having the guts to even attempt sneaking past me.
Eunhwa quickly raises her weapon to open fire.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: *Sigh*... You're becoming quite irksome. Take this.
*Crack crack!*

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Argh!
Crystal spikes shoot up from the ground, piercing through Eunhwa's body.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Eunhwa!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: She's been hit all over!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I made sure to stick you nice and proper. You'll become nourishment for them in no time.

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: My body... it's getting stiff...!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Let's see how you like this.
*Whoosh*
Behemoth swings her clamps in a wide-sweeping motion.
*Swooooosh*
Everyone is sent careening backwards.
This is impossible!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Why would you say that? The world is full of strange and mysterious things.
Behemoth walks over and uses her clamps to lift Grave off the ground.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: Argh...!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I'll be taking that coffin back, thank you very much.

lines.speaker: grave
lines.text: You... can't have it!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I figured that's what you'd say.

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: You're not taking it.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Hmm? Was your hair always that color?

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: Not your business.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Come on, tell me.
Rapi rushes in.
Behemoth tosses Grave towards Rapi,
but she catches her and places her to the side.
Meanwhile, Behemoth's clamp swings forth and latches onto Rapi.

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: Oh no you don't!
*Clank*
Rapi catches the clamp with both of her hands.
*Creak* *Creak*
The earsplitting sound of creaking metal fills the air.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: You've gotten stronger!

lines.speaker: rapi_r
lines.text: I won't let you beat me again.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Big words for a puny being.
*Crack*
The clamp closes,
and Rapi is completely engulfed by it.
A shocked look of dismay runs across her face,
and just as our eyes are about to meet, she is completely subsumed by the pincer.
*Bang bang bang bang*
Behemoth slams the clamp
which is holding Rapi repeatedly onto the ground.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Argh!
*Bang bang bang bang*
*Bang*
Rapi!
There is no response.
Her hair color has returned to normal.
Rapi!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Call her all you want, she won't be getting up.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Hey.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: How long are you going to keep following me?
As long as I have to.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: And when you catch up to me?
*Kagagagagak*
The area surrounding me is immediately covered in crystals.
She's able to do this all seemingly without lifting a finger...

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: What exactly is your plan?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: How do you intend on besting someone as powerful as I?
It's a secret.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Haha. Really?
We have a secret weapon, so you better watch out.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I might have fallen for that bluff if you'd managed to keep your voice from shaking.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Do you know why I haven't killed every last one of you?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: It would be so easy. I could walk over and crush all your heads like watermelons right now.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Why don't you think I'm doing that?
Because you want to open the coffin.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: That's true as well, but there's an even more important reason.
Are you lonely?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: How did you know? Is it that obvious?
Don't mess with me, Heretic.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Oh, I'm being quite serious.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: There are only four of us, so we always end up talking about the same things.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: We get along swimmingly as well, and never fight, which is excruciatingly boring.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I've tried striking up a conversation with Grave numerous times, but as you know, she's hardly a skilled conversationalist.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Conversation is the foundation of evolution.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I need someone to talk to.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: So I thought, why not let you tag along and entertain me?
You sound like a villain from a bad action movie.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Every villain has their own set of ideals.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I've got to go. See you around.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: You ought to be careful, by the way.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: You still have something that I want.
I won't give it to you.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Hehe, that's precisely what makes it all so fun.
Behemoth disappears with the coffin in tow.
Shifty, check everyone's condition.

lines.speaker: shifty_c
lines.text: They're all knocked out cold.

lines.speaker: shifty_c
lines.text: You should get out of here immediately. If any Raptures come here...
What should I do?

lines.speaker: shifty_c
lines.text: Get yourself and everyone to a safe location.

lines.speaker: shifty_c
lines.text: However, there's no way a human can lift up a Nikke. They're far too h...
Hrrrrnnngh!
I lift Rapi.

lines.speaker: shifty_c
lines.text: ... heavy.
Tell me where I need to go.

lines.speaker: shifty_c
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: shifty_c
lines.text: There's a glass building 50 meters northeast of you. It should be safe there for now.
G... Got it...!

lines.speaker: shifty_c
lines.text: You're not planning on moving everyone, are you?

lines.speaker: shifty_c
lines.text: It's not possible! There's no way you can move seven Nikkes!
I can... do it!

lines.speaker: shifty_c
lines.text: ... Understood. I'll continue monitoring the area. You just keep walking straight.

lines.speaker: shifty_c
lines.text: Hold on, I'm picking up vital signs from Grave!

lines.speaker: grave_no
lines.text: Urgh...

lines.speaker: grave_no
lines.text: I... I can help.
Okay, thanks.

lines.speaker: grave_no
lines.text: No, thank you.
